crossRefs.note: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf…

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A place where Israel camped in the wilderness

translations.web: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
translations.bsb: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
